title: Manager - Market Research
description:
Job Description: The Business Development Representative (BDR) will play a pivotal role in the outbound and inbound prospecting efforts of the EXL Growth Office. The BDR will collaborate closely with the sales team to drive new business opportunities and contribute to the overall growth strategy for the Media segment within the Communication, Media and Entertainment (CME) industry. This role will focus on account and contact research, sales engagement outreach, collaboration with sales leadership, sales representatives they support, and marketing to identify relevant prospects and position EXL’s data, AI, analytics, digital operations, and transformation capabilities.

  

Responsibilities: Responsibilities:

* Collaborate with sales team to identify target accounts and contacts.

* Execute, monitor, and track progress with targeted outbound sales campaigns by line of business and market.

* Employ a consultative approach to understand prospect needs and articulate the unique value our products/services offer.

* Inbound Prospecting: Efficiently qualify inbound leads generated through marketing efforts. Respond to the inbound emails within the stipulated timeline and seamlessly transition them to the sales team.

* Market Research: Conduct periodic market research on prospects to enhance the understanding of their priorities.

* Maintain targeted account lists across Media sub-segments including TV, OTT and streaming platforms, media players, production studios, broadcasting networks, and music and radio companies and develop persona-led messaging for the same.

* Identify relevant buying centers and personas within media such as audience growth, subscriber management, ad sales/ad operations, content monetization, distribution, product, data/analytics, digital, finance, legal, and customer experience leaders.

* Leverage various databases and tools, including but not limited to ZoomInfo, XIQ insights, and other forthcoming tools integrated into Salesforce.

* Messaging Development : Create and optimize inbound and outbound call scripts tailored to specific industries, pain points, and value propositions.

* Develop segmented outreach messaging around Media priorities such as audience insights, subscriber acquisition and retention, content valuation, content performance tracking,

advertising yield optimization, cross-platform consumption, and AI-led digital transformation.

* Track industry triggers relevant to media accounts, including streaming growth, D2C transformation, ad revenue, content cost optimization, viewership fragmentation, churn reduction, rights/licensing changes, and AI adoption across media operations.

* Create targeted messaging by line of business and persona to align outbound messaging with overall brand positioning and marketing campaigns.

* Collaboration and Communication: Foster communication, collaboration, and reporting with the sales, marketing, SWAT, and other cross-functional teams.

* Share data insights and feedback from outbound efforts to continually refine message development and outreach approaches.

* Reporting and Analysis: Utilize CRM tools to plan and track activities, update prospect information, and generate reports on performance metrics.

* Analyze call data and outcomes to identify trends, successes, and areas for improvement.

  

* Qualifications: · Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required.

* 5 years of experience in Inside sales, Business Development or similar role, preferably in analytics, digital operations and digital transformation sales operations.

* Ability to translate pain points into compelling outreach narratives aligned to analytics, digital operations, and transformation-led value propositions.

Good to have:

* Experience prospecting into Media, Broadcasting, or adjacent B2B sectors.

* Strong understanding of the Media ecosystem, including TV, OTT/streaming, production studios, broadcasting, music and radio, and the commercial priorities of these business es.

* Prior exposure to media go-to-market motions, account-based marketing, revenue operations, or CRM-led sales campaigns across Media, OTT, music/radio or broadcasting accounts.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
**About Rackspace Cyber Defence**

Rackspace Cyber Defence is our next generation cyber defence and security operations capability that builds on 20+ years of securing customer environments to deliver proactive, risk-based, threat-informed and intelligence driven security services.

**Our purpose** is to enable our customers to defend against the evolving threat landscape across on-premises, private cloud, public cloud and multi-cloud workloads.

**Our goal** is to go beyond traditional security controls to deliver cloud-native, DevOps-centric and fully integrated 24x7x365 cyber defence capabilities that deliver a **proactive** , **threat-informed** , **risk-based** , **intelligence-driven** approach to detecting and responding to threats.

**Our mission** is to help our customers:

* Proactively detect and respond to cyber-attacks – 24x7x365.
* Defend against new and emerging risks that impact their business.
* Reduce their attack surface across private cloud, hybrid cloud, public cloud, and multi-cloud environments.
* Reduce their exposure to risks that impact their identity and brand.
* Develop operational resilience.
Maintain compliance with legal, regulatory and compliance obligations.  

  
  

**What we’re looking for**

To support our continued success and deliver a Fanatical Experience™ to our customers, Rackspace Cyber Defence is looking for an India-based Security Delivery Manager.

This role is particularly well-suited to a self-starting, experienced and motivated Security Delivery Manager, who is commercially-aware, service-oriented and has a proven record of accomplishment in service delivery management, service management and/or customer success.

The Security Delivery Manager will be the face of Rackspace’s security services, delivering excellent customer service for our customers. Core delivery areas will include service delivery management, operational governance, contractual management, and financial performance.

**Key Accountabilities**

* **Service Delivery Management**
  + Oversight of customer onboarding and service transition.
  + Own the customer relationship and act as the customer’s key contact for your assigned customers.
  + Act as a service escalation point for internal and external teams (e.g. during major incidents.)
  + Prepare and deliver Monthly Security Service Reviews (MSSRs)
  + Serve as the operational interlock between customers and Rackspace delivery team(s).
  + Collaborate with wider account team(s) to deliver strategic initiatives.
  + Provide on-call services to customers (if applicable)
  + Proactively engage customers and identify opportunities for continual service improvement (CSI)
  + Build strong relationships with assigned customers and understand their business challenges.
  + Identify and drive opportunities to grow assigned accounts, in collaboration with the wider account team(s)
  + Solicit customer feedback ,testimonials, case studies and references to support both Customer Success and continuous improvement initiatives.
  + Willing to work in flexible working hours.
* **Operational Governance**
  + Regular engagement with internal service providers
  + Managing the performance of internal teams
  + Driving customer outcomes through service delivery teams
  + Assist in the development of policies and standards with specific regard to service design, service transition, service management and continuous service improvement.
  + Maintain service documentation to ensure business visibility of service processes.
* **Contractual Management**
  + Be the subject matter experts for your customers’ security contracts.
  + Ensuring new requirements are captured and contractually incorporated.
  + Ensure the required teams are engaged for key contractual milestones e.g renewals.
* **Financial Performance**
  + Monitor and manage the financial performance for your assigned customers contracts.
  + Forecast financial performance throughout the life of the service.
  + Highlight key commercial levers that may affect financial performance to key internal stakeholders.
  + Where possible, identify and deliver financial performance enhancing measures.

**Skills & Experience**

* Should have 5+ years’ experience in service delivery management, service management and/or customer success; ideally within a managed security services (MSSP) environment.
* Experience in monitoring and improving service performance.
* Managing key stakeholders both internal and external, understanding expected outcomes
* Experience of working with public cloud environments such as Azure, AWS and Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience of common service management standards such as ITIL or ISO 20000; as well as service transition.
* Knowledge of common project management practices such as Prince II, Agile and SCRUM; ideally in a DevOps-centric environment.
* Knowledge of security standards (good practice) such as NIST, ISO27001, CIS (Center for Internet Security), OWASP and Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) etc
* Ideally, you will have experience delivering managed security services such as Attack Surface Management, Managed Detection & Response, Managed Extended Detection & Response and/or Defensive Security Services.
* A highly self-motivated and proactive individual who wants to learn and grow and has an attention to detail.
* Highly organised and detail oriented. Ability to prioritise, multitask and work under pressure.
* An individual who shows a willingness to go above and beyond in delighting the customer.
* A good communicator who can explain security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

**About Rackspace Technology**

Rackspace Technology is the trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production. From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that regulated and mission-critical environments demand. We support customers in more than 120 countries with AI capabilities spanning private cloud, public cloud, applications, data and cyber resilience.

  

**More on Rackspace Technology**

Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. And we embrace the notion that unique perspectives fuel innovation and enable us to best serve our customers and communities around the globe. title: Head of Customer Expansion
description:
**About OneMetric:**

OneMetric (formerly Growtomation) is a revenue enablement partner for B2B teams. We build revenue engines end to end: the systems and data the teams run on, the GTM execution that turns them into demand, closed deals, and retention, and the AI that makes the whole engine faster and smarter.

As an Elite HubSpot Partner, we work with high-growth companies across the US and globally, and we start with the real revenue problem, not the tool. Most companies buy these three pieces from three different vendors, then wonder why nothing connects. We run them as one.

**The problem we want to solve**  
Our account managers and delivery leads own our client relationships today, and they do it well. But those relationships are built around the service the client hired us for, often CRM / RevOps work.

OneMetric now does more than CRM / RevOps. We also do go-to-market (GTM) strategy, consulting, web experiences, and AI transformation. Most clients don’t know that, because we haven’t built relationships with their senior leaders, like the CMO or CRO, or gone deep on their revenue problems.

We need someone to build on the trust our delivery teams have earned. Your job is to get closer to the C-suite, understand what’s holding back their revenue, and show where we can help beyond the original project.

**What you’ll do**

***Own the strategy***

* Set the plan for how we keep and grow our clients. Your goals are net revenue retention (NRR) in a few customers and client lifetime value (LTV), in many of them.
* Decide which accounts to grow, how, and in what order.

***Own the relationships***

* Be the main contact for senior leaders in our largest accounts.
* Act as a trusted advisor to their C-suite. Learn their revenue goals and problems, and talk in business terms, not tool terms.
* Work with account managers and delivery leads to map each account: who we know, who we don’t, and who matters.
* Build new relationships beyond our current champion, both up and across the client’s leadership team.
* Keep in regular touch with your accounts to learn what they need next and fix concerns early.

***Grow revenue***

* Work with Sales to sell more of what we do: GTM strategy, consulting, web experiences, and AI transformation.
* Add value in our customer marketing programs, like case studies and client stories, so strong relationships turn into visible proof.
* Spot churn risks early, and have a plan ready for each one.
* Build the process for taking new services to existing clients.

***Build & Lead the team***

* Build the team of customer success managers
* Lead, coach, and develop them.
* Teach account managers and delivery leads how to grow accounts the way you do.
* Plan who can step up next, so the team keeps growing.

**Minimum requirements**

* 10 to 12 years in a similar role at a services company.
* US-based clients with contracts worth $100K or more a year.
* Strong B2B marketing basics. You can hold a real conversation with a CMO or CRO about pipeline and growth.
* Proven experience growing inside an account, not just up. For example, you started with a head of martech and built the relationship until you were working with the CMO.
* Experience leading and coaching a team.
* Strongly preferred: experience at a digital, marketing, martech, RevOps, Salesforce, or HubSpot agency.
